item.title: DTE gives tips on keeping your bills low during freezing temperatures
item.description: As freezing weather hit Metro Detroit communities, many have had to increase the setting on their thermostats, adding more pain to their wallets when the eventual bill comes in. Some customers are digging deep into their wallets to pay for this increase and the harsh reality is that the cold weather is not going anywhere anytime soon. item.title: ICE makes arrest at Hazel Park warehouse after vehicle pursuit, spokesperson says
item.description: An undocumented immigrant from Venezuela was arrested by ICE in Hazel Park, a spokesperson told FOX 2 on Monday.Edwin Romero Guttierez was arrested by ICE on Feb. 2 when federal agents attempted to pull Guttierez's car over. The ICE spokesperson said he then sped off away from them, nearly hitting other vehicles.Federal officials say he then approached a warehouse, exited the car and ran off on foot. item.title: Metro Detroit activist Ismael Ahmed dies at the age of 78
item.description: Metro Detroit lost a legend over the weekend, Ismael Ahmed, a man who left a mark on everything he did, from social services to music.It was a sad time for many. Ahmed was a beloved community activist who served in government. item.title: Vendors in Monroe turned away from Oddities and Horror Festival due to no more room
item.description: It was quite an unexpected fright for vendors hoping to show off and sell their freaky items at the Michigan Oddities & Horror Fest in Monroe over the weekend.Several of them were told there was no room for them to set up shop after they paid to take part.There’s a big community of fans of all things horror across the Midwest, and the Michigan Oddities & Horror Fest is a home base for those folks. Basically, anything you can imagine that would be scary or outlandish can be bought and sold there.

item.title: Ex-Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick makes deal to pay over $800K in restitution, court documents say
item.description: Ex-Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick has reached an agreement with federal prosecutors regarding more than $823,000 in remaining restitution to the city, according to court filings.An amended judgment ordered Kilpatrick to pay about $1.7 million in restitution, and the federal government has been pursuing collection through garnishment actions, including filing writs as recently as December 2025.Kilpatrick filed motions in both cases arguing that his restitution obligation should be considered full
